proposed_net_changes: U12.8, R37.1, R38.1, R40.1 and U12 local bypass positive to V3V3 together
Keep R12 charge-disable pullup on VBUS_LIMITED
advantage: With a live MCU rail, USB insertion no longer power-cycles the comparator or divider references.
required_before_adoption: Check actual 3.3V regulator tolerance and startup/brownout waveform
Specify and enforce MCU BOR threshold above comparator minimum operating voltage plus margin
Keep CHG_ALLOW low during reset/boot and until comparator readiness delay expires
Verify removal of USB also clears permission; retained-high hotplug is handled only if logic supply remains valid
Recalculate qualified sensor R-T envelope and comparator error at actual input common mode
Add comparator and divider consumption to battery-side budget through actual regulator efficiency
limits: 33mV offset-plus-hysteresis is a sensitivity allowance, not a guaranteed composite bound
Constant beta approximation and +/-1% NTC assumptions do not replace manufacturer R-T tolerances
3.3V +/-5% is an exploration range, not a measured or sourced rail specification
Logic-rail mAh is not battery mAh; regulator loss and voltage conversion not included
No hardware startup or cell temperature qualification claim
